# Awwwards

> > Awwwards is the leading international award platform for recognizing excellence in web design, creativity, and digital innovation.

Awwwards curates and celebrates the best websites globally through a competitive awards system, featuring daily/monthly/yearly recognition, jury-based judging, and a comprehensive gallery of design inspiration across multiple categories and industries.

## Key Topics

- Web Design Awards
- Design Inspiration
- Portfolio Showcase
- User Experience (UX/UI)
- Animation & Motion
- Web Design Trends
- Design Agencies
- Typography
- Scrolling Techniques
- Website Gallery
- Developer Awards
- Creative Excellence
- Design Showcase
- Industry Recognition

## Award Recognition & Leaderboards

- [Awwwards - Website Awards - Best Web Design Trends](https://www.awwwards.com): Awwwards homepage showcasing website awards and design trends
- [Sites Of The Year - Awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/sites_of_the_year): Annual best websites and top design projects of the year
- [Sites Of The Month - Awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/sites_of_the_month): Monthly featured award-winning websites and design showcase
- [Sites Of The Day - Awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/sites_of_the_day): Daily featured award-winning websites and design recognition
- [Most Awarded Profiles - Awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com/winner-list): Leaderboard of most awarded designers, agencies, and freelancers
- [Honors - Awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com/honors/winners): Web creators honored for excellence in design and functionality

## Design Gallery & Inspiration

- [Winning websites. Web Design Inspiration - Awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com/websites): Main gallery of award-winning website designs and inspiration
- [Nominees - Awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/nominees): Nominated websites and voting showcase for Awwwards competition
- [Best Portfolio Websites | Web Design Inspiration](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/portfolio): Curated portfolio website designs and creative inspiration
- [Best Web Agencies Websites](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/design-agencies): Web agency and designer portfolio websites and design trends

## Design Techniques & Specializations

- [Best Animation Websites | Web Design Inspiration](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/animation): Animation-focused websites with CSS3, SVG, and WebGL effects
- [Best Scroll Websites | Web Design Inspiration](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/scrolling): Websites featuring innovative scrolling and motion techniques
- [Best UX/UI Design Inspiration Sites](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/ui-design): UI/UX design inspiration and user experience examples

## Industry-Specific Design Showcase

- [Best Architectural Design Websites](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/architecture): Architecture studio websites and professional design examples
- [Best Photography websites | Web Design Inspiration](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/photography): Photography portfolio websites and photographer design inspiration
- [Hotel & Restaurant Design websites](https://www.awwwards.com/websites/hotel-restaurant): Hospitality and restaurant website design showcase and examples
